tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bod dang bod chen ljongs rnams su/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin mchog rnams la/ /bsnyen bkur mchod sprin 'bul ba'i tho/ /puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i phreng 'ad
༄༅/ /bod dang bod chen ljongs rnams su/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin mchog rnams la/ /bsnyen bkur mchod sprin 'bul ba'i tho/ /puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i phreng 'ad

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bod dang bod chen ljongs rnams su// bstan dang bstan 'dzin mchog rnams la// bsnyen bkur mchod sprin 'bul ba'i tho// puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i phreng 'dir gsal//

aṅgi ra zhes chu sprel lor// bod yul dbus gyi rgyal rnams la// dngos 'bul tho yig tshigs bcad phreng*// bkod rnams 'di na gsal bar bya// de yang dang po skyabs mchog rgyal dbang rin po che'i zhabs drung du phul ba ni/ oṃ swa sti dza yan+tu/ mtha' yas srid par phrin las rgya mtsho yi// thugs rje chen po'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba can// mi bzad snying rje'i rnam par 'phrul pa las// tshar du dngar ba rim byon mu tig phreng*// mchog gi dpal ldan rdo rje can dngos che// dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon// gang de'i zhabs pad rdo rje g.yung drung dang*// seng ges btegs pa'i khri 'phang lhar bcas pa// che dgu'i gtsug gi nor bus mngon btud pa'i// bsngags 'os phyag byar gyur pa gang drung du// phun sum tshogs pa'i rab dge'i dus kyi char// gus pas yid kyi dang ba bskyed bzhin du// lus kyi gnas lnga sa la reg nas su// ngag gi sdeb legs lha yi rol mo bkrol// ka ma la yi char chen phyogs kun tu// 'thor bar byas nas mgon po khyod nyid kyi// gsang gsum rnam thar rig pa'i ā dar+sha// gsal bar bkod nas shis pa'i tshig gi phreng*/ tam+bu ra yi rgyud kyi bstod pa ni// deng yang 'byams klas bskal pa'i gong rol nas// stobs bcu mnga' ba rnams las ches lhag pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa'i brtse chen ye shes ngang*// mngon par byang chub nyid na'ang gzhan snang ngor// yal bar 'dor med chos dbyings klong yangs su// byams pa'i shugs kyis bskul ba'i khyung sngon skyes// legs byas bye ba'i bsod nams 'od ris kyis// drangs nas shar ri'i rtse las nyin mor byed// ji bzhin rdzu 'phrul rta bdun shing rta yis// btegs nas dzam gling skye dgu'i mchod sdong du// gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor cha rdzogs lham me ba// nges gsang ring lugs yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa'i bdag

/ma 'dris yid can gdul bya'i skyed mos tshal// phan bde'i 'dab stong grol ba'i gnyen gcig pu// ma smad rnam dpyod phrin las 'jug pa gang*// gzhan dring mi 'jog rgyal rnams 'gro phan gyi// tshul la bsnyel ba med bzhin gang 'dir yang*// rdo rje'i sku ni mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba// mthong thos dran tsam bde ba che thob pa// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi byin bsdus las// lhag pa'i gter chen gang khyod las gzhan su// rdo rje'i gsung ni yan lag drug cur ldan// 'gags med dbyangs kyi grag stong seng ge'i sgra// lung dang rigs pa'i nga ros rgol ngan rnams// mthar byed ngag gi dbang phyug gang las ci// rdo rje'i thugs ni mi g.yo gsum ldan ngang*// zab zhi spros bral ting 'dzin phrag brgya yi// yon tan ma 'dres so sor gsal ston pa'i// dus gsum kun mkhyen gzigs pa nyid las gang*// de lta'i dpag par dka' ba'i ya mtshan gyis// phyur bur gtams pa dgos 'byung dbang rgyal bzhin// lha dbang ral pa'i zur phud rtse mos mchod// gser mngal can dang 'jig rten skyong ba yi// grags ldan chen por gyur pa rnams kyis kyang*// khengs pa bskyungs nas mgon khyod zhabs pad+mo// ge sar rgyas pa'i ngogs su bsnyen byas nas// dam pa'i bdud rtsi'i zho shas 'tsho bzhin par// dkar po'i phyogs kun rgyal ba'i ba dan bsgrengs// de mthu'i dpal las srid zhi'i dge mtshan ni// rtag par nongs med rgyal khams rdzogs ldan dus// dang por spyod pa ji lta'i bsod nams gang*// mi bzad gter chen bum pa bzang po ltar// 'di kwa gang gi thugs rje'i cha shas kyi// 'phrul las grub pa de las gzhan su zhig /des na 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod kho na// bse ru lta bur nges pa'i gang 'dir yang*// bdag sogs tshogs gnyis ma lus rdzogs slad du// dad gsum blo yis gsol gdab las byung ba'i// mthong dang thos dang dran tsam grol ba yi// rdzu 'phrul bkod pa'i rang gzugs las grub pa'i// rang rtags mi bskyod rigs kyi cod pan can// lta bas mi ngoms byin gzi rab 'bar ba// thod du bcings nas gdul bya skal ldan rnams// 'brel tshad yang dag lam la dkri ba yi// ring nas sngon goms thugs bskyed dam bca'i khur// zab mo rjes su dgongs pa'i byang chub che'i// go 'phang bde blag ston phyir bden pa'i tshig

/rdo rje'i gsung gi brjod dang lhan cig ngang*// byams chen dbyings nas brtse bzhes srid pa'i 'gro// yal bar 'dor med 'khor ba'i chu bo las// brgal dka'i ngan song duḥkhas gtses pa dag /gang gi thugs rje'i gru gzings la brten nas// myang 'das thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar// 'jug pa'i phrin las nam mkha'i khams su yang*// shong bar dka' ba'i rang bzhin las 'das kyang*// mos pa'i blo yis yar gzhal ma yin par// mngon sum tshad mas grub 'di ngo mtshar phul// bka' drin 'khor mtha' bral ba'i tshad bzung ba// chu lhas lce brgya bskyod kyang brjod mi nus// des na bdag lta so skyes lta ci smos// 'on kyang sa mu dra las nyar ma tsam// gus pas ku sha'i rtse mos 'thor ba 'di'i// legs byas dge mtshan bsod nams dpal thob snyam// deng 'dir rgyal ba'i zhal lta chos mnyan phyir// gtang rag dngos po'i bdog pa pad snal ltar// phra yang lhag bsam dag pas kun bslangs nas// rgya mtsho'i gos can dog par byed nus pa'i// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du dmigs pa yis// rab 'byams mtha' yas zhing rnams ma lus par// maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bsdus nas 'bul lags na// brtse bas dgongs te dgyes par bzhes su gsol// zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i ched du brjod pas mdun bdar bar byas nas/ de yang gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'og min dpal gyi mtshur phu'i gan+dho la'i gzhal med khang ma bzhengs lhun gyis grub pa lta bu 'dir/ dus phun sum tshogs pa rta ldan ma nya ba'i rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus chen dang nye bar au ḍi ya na'i a tsār+ya'i dus bzang por dkar phyogs kyi yar tshes bcu la/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa gru 'dzin bdag po'i phreng ba rim par byon pa las bcu bzhi pa/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba theg pa mchog gi rdo rje 'chang chen po 'tsho zhing gzhes pa la/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa tshe rabs nas rjes su 'brel ba'i sngon smon las 'phro dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang mchog dman bar ma'i skye bo sna tshogs kyi dbus su/

chos phun sum tshogs pa mthong ba tsam gyis grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs rjen par 'char nus pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od dang ldan pa/ mthon mthing gnam sngon zhun ma'i ngos la/ rab gsal nyin mor byed pa'i 'od mdangs kyis brgyan pa lta bu'i/ dbu zhwa rin po che dbu la bzhes nas 'brel tshad yang dag pa'i lam la bkod par mdzad nas/ sems can dbugs ma dbyung ba rnams dbugs 'byin pa dang*/ ma brgal ba rnams brgal ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams grol ba'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i snying rje chen pos nye bar khyab par gnang ba'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dngos po'i yo byad chu thigs tsam stob pa'i tho gsal du bkod pa la/ thog mar bkra shis pa'i lha'i reg bya gangs ri'i mdangs can srid na ring ba phon tshar ma nyams pa/ sku rten shākya'i rgyal po'i gser sku/ gsung rten tshe mdo/ thugs rten bka' gdams mchod rten/ gdan dkar rdo rje'i re khā bkra ba/ rdor dril/ rgya sbub spus legs/ gos chen cod ldan sgril kha/ yang gos chen si'u sbu can sgril/ zhabs chag cha/ tshan dang por lha rdzas/ gos dmar smug yug bcas dgu tshan/ tshan gnyis par lha rdzas/ gos ser smug yug bcas dgu tshan/ tshan gsum par lha rdzas/ gos smyug kha yug bcas dgu tshan/ tshan bzhi par lha rdzas/ gos ser yug bcas bdun tshan/ tshan lnga par lha rdzas/ gos sngon yug bcas bdun tshan/ tshan drug par lha rdzas/ 'ga' khra yug bcas bdun tshan/ tshan bdun pa lha rdzas/ srang le bcas lnga tshan/ chibs bkra shis dung dar/ yang chibs sngo skya/ chibs hrol gnyis/ dkyus rta bcu gsum/ dre'u gsum/ mdzo bcu/ khal bco lnga/ ja chung 'ju 'khor drug cu/ ko rtse 'khor drug bco lnga/ dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu/ mtha' dkar ka ci yug bcas khyon brgya phrag gnyis dang yon tan nor lha'i grangs ldan bcas 'bul lam zhu/ slar yang gsol ba/ gdod nas lhun grub chos dbyings ye shes las// yongs grub bde chen sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar// sprul pa'i rnam rol gzugs kyi skur snang ba// zhing 'dir gdul bya'i mgon du bskal pa'i bar// steng phyogs yon tan dpag med mgon po bzhin// mi 'gyur rdo rje chos bdun ngo bo ru// nam mkha' ji srid gnas dang de srid kyi// bar du rdo rje'i khri la rtag bzhugs nas// smin grol dam chos bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis// 'gro mang theg pa mchog la bsgyur ba yi// phrin las khyab dang rtag pa'i bdag nyid kyis// srid zhi'i 'ching ba kun las bsgral du gsol// bkra shis gang zhig tshad med byams pa'i thugs rje'i mkha' dbyings las// yongs shar rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rta bdun dbang po'i 'od stong can// phrin las rnam bzhi'i gzi 'bar rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs khyab pa'i// bkra shis des kyang nges gsang ring lugs pad tshal bzhad gyur cig

/bkra shis gang zhig 'dus ma byas pa'i rang gdangs rtsal 'khrungs pa'i// zhi dang khro tshogs dag pa rab 'byams skur ston lha yi lha// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'dod 'jo ka na ka yi rtsibs stong ldan// bkra shis des kyang gling bzhir dbang bsgyur skye dgu bde gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig zhi las ma g.yos mngon spyod rol pa che'i// bdud dgra mthar byed dpa' bo 'jig rten gsum las rgyal ba po// chos 'khor skyong la g.yel ba med pa'i mthu ldan mel tshe can// bkra shis des kyang phyogs rnams kun las rnam par rgyal gyur cig /dza ya dza ya/ su dza ya/ sarba maṅga lam/// / ༈ gus phran bla ma gar dbang pas dngos 'bul maṇ+ḍal mtshon byed kyi tho chung*/ oṃ swa sti/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi// mi bzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo lnga'i// bdag nyid chen po rigs kun gyi// khyab bdag dang po'i rdo rje 'chang*// gang gi zhabs pad 'char ka'i 'od// dri bral chu 'dzin ldan de'i drung*// rab gus sgo gsum 'dud pa bcas// lag pad tshangs gnas bzlums byas nas// mchog gi yon tan rgya mtsho las// dad pas kun blangs 'di skad gsol// smon lam zab mo'i legs byas 'phrul// rten cing 'brel ba'i dus kyi char// chos dbyings rtag brtan 'dus ma byas// yongs grub kun bzang klong yangs por// gdod nas bde bar gshegs rnams las// ye sangs rgyas pa zin na yang*// srid pa'i 'khor ba gnas kyi bar// thugs rje'i lha lam khyon yangs nas// sems can phra mo'i phyir yang ni// bskal par bsnyel med phrin las kyi// ka ru ṇi ka'i rang mdangs las// 'khrungs pa'i nor bu pad+ma can// gang gi rnam rol chu zla'i gar// mi mjed 'jig rten bye ba brgyar// mtha' klas sprul pa'i tsan+d+ra gsal// gdul bya'i khams dbang sna tshogs ngor// mos pa'i stobs kyi bsod nams zhing*// dzam+bu bṛk+ṣas mtshan pa'i gling*// byang phyogs bsil ldan bho ṭa'i ljongs// deng 'dir gdul bya'i bgo skal du// lha rnams kun gyi lhar gyur bzhin// rdo rje gsum ldan sku'i dkyil 'khor*// ri bong 'dzin pa'i cha gang ba// phrin las 'od dkar zer phreng gis// mnyam med shākya'i ring lugs gang*// sde snod gsum gyi ku muta tshal// gcig char 'dzum pa'i gnyen dam pa// bstan 'dzin rgyu skar phreng ba'i dbus// khyod kyi rnam dpyod chu shel dbang*// bsgrun du med pa'i rang bzhin can// bdag sogs gdul bya'i mos pa'i mkha'// dang ba'i ngogs su mngon sum nyid// mthong tsam mod la grol nus pa'i// thugs rje'i snang byed bskul ba las// cod pan mthon ka'i mdangs 'tsher ba// ḍā ki'i dbang zhu 'ching nas su// 'brel dang 'brel par gyur pa rnams// phyam gcig bde chen lam bkod pa'i// phul byung thugs bskyed rgya chen po// gang gi bka' drin brjod 'das kyang*// dngos 'byor rngo ma thogs na'ang*// 'on kyang dus gsum bsags yod kyi// dge tshogs gcig tu bzlums byas nas// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung du// dmigs nas 'bul gyi brtse chen gyis// dgongs pa'i klong nas bzhes su gsol// zhes mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang nas maṇ+ḍal dngos po'i rten 'byung du bstar ba'i thog mar bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas rab dkar maṅga'i re khā bkra ba/

sku rten ār+ya tā re'i zhal thang*/ gsung rten tshe mdo gzungs/ thugs rten bka' gdams mchod rten/ gdan dkar rdo rje dang g.yung drung gi ri mos mtshan pa/ dar dkar yug /ling yug /zam yug gnyis/ g.yi lpags/ gzig lpags/ rol mo/ dpa' dam/ dngul srang nyer lnga/ mdzo gsum/ mdzo mo gnyis/ khal bzhi/ sga stan cha lnga/ chu 'jug 'khor drug cu/ mar ltang gnyis/ rta chibs chen/ chibs rol/ dkyus rta/ dre'u/ mtha' dkar bcas phul ba brtse chen ye shes klong yangs dam par bsti ba ci nas mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhu/ slar yang gsol ba/ de ltar tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'khor lo yis// drangs pa'i lhag blo'i 'dun pa mi phyed pa'i// stobs las byung ba'i dge rtsa mi bzad par// nam mkha' mdzod bzhin phyur bur 'gengs pa'i mthus// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan// nges don mthar thug dbu ma'i bzhed srol gyi// bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng*// dge 'dun sde rgyas mnga' ris bde ldan zhing*// rtag par nongs med bkra shis phun sum tshogs// rnam kun bsam don chos bzhin lhun grub shog /sarba dza ga taṃ shu bha mastu/// / ༈ de nas dpal ldan 'brug pa rgyal dbang brgyad pa'i drung du phul pa'i tho yig ni/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i mi bzad rgyan 'khor lnga'i// bdag nyid chen por yongs grub rigs kun gyi// khyab bdag dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' dbang phyug /rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi skur snang ba// chos kun chags thogs med par mkhyen cing gzigs// de phyir byang 'phags rnams kyi'ang spyi rgyan du// mchod 'os nyid na srid zhi'i dpal mgon por// gdod nas nges pa gang de'i zhabs chu skyes// dri med 'dab rgyas mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri// lhar bcas gtsug gi nor bus 'degs pa'i drung*// rab gus dad pa'i lag pad zum bzhin par// dang ba'i yid kyis gang gi rnam par thar// gan+dhar dpal mo'i rgyud mangs la drangs te// ngag gi gling bur bsgyur nas 'di skad gsol// deng yang dge legs rmad byung ngo mtshar gzhi// dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos po kun// yongs 'du dbyar rnga'i sgra yis sa gsum gnas// lus can mdongs mtha' yas rnams dga' bskyed pa'i// rdzogs ldan sprin phreng gsar pa dkrigs pa yi// dpyid kyi lang tsho bzhad pa'i dus kyi char// brjod bral dpag par dka' ba'i rang bzhin can// rdul snyed bskal mang gong nas gzhan phan don// 'dren pa gzhan las lhag pa'i sems bskyed kyi// dam bca' zab mo'i pha rol phyin pa las// 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las bsnyel med slad// mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya zin mod kyang*// gdul bya rgya mtsho'i gos can dog gyur pa'i// snyigs lnga'i 'gro la brtse bas rjes chags nas// ma 'dris ded dpon nyid du dus gsum gyi// bde gshegs kun kyi dgongs klong gcig bsdus phyir// mi bzad thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las// cir yang 'char ba'i chu zla'i gar bsgyur ba// mos pa'i yid mkhar gzugs sku ri bong 'dzin// bral smin yon tan cha gang yongs rdzogs pa// rigs drug duḥkha'i zhugs lce mthar byed pa'i// byams pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar bsil sbyin cing*// yang dag thar pa'i lam mchog gsal ba'i gnyen// 'jig rten gsum gyi phyag gi gnas gcig pu// rdo rje'i sku mchog mtshan dpe lham me ba// mthong tsam grol bas mngon mtho nges legs kyi// sar bkod de phyir phyag na pad+ma 'chang*// dbyer med don gyi ye shes rnam rol mtshungs// rdo rje'i gsung gsang yan lag drug cur ldan// thos pas srid 'gro 'khor mtsho na kra yi// 'jigs skyob 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i ngang tshul bzhin// ji snyed shes bya thogs med kun mkhyen pa// rdo rje'i thugs ni ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong*// gcig char ston pa'i 'jug sgo mtha' yas phul// dran pa'i mod la bdud bzhi'i dpung gzhom pa'i// khro chen gsang bdag rdor 'dzin rgyal po dngos// yon tan rdo rje rnam bzhi lhun grub pa// 'dod dgu'i gter chen bsam 'phel bum pa bzang*// bsod nams rin chen bye ba'i 'byung gnas mchog

/tshe 'od dpag med ston pa mngon du grub// phrin las rdo rje don dam snang cha'i ngor// rgyal kun 'dus pa'i rang rtsal he ru ka /mtshor 'khrungs sangs rgyas pad skyes mi gnyis par// gsang sngags gnas la sgrib med spyan lnga ldan// sngon tshe byang chub sbyangs yon 'bras smin stobs// rten 'byung dus kyis bskyed pa'i bskal bzang 'dir// 'phags yul grub gtso yongs 'du sa brtol ljon// ji bzhin paṇa chen nā ro ta pa'i zhabs// bstan pa yongs rdzogs lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas// lung rigs man ngag me tog rnam par bkra// phyi rol rgol ngan sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs can// kun kyang dharma'i zil mngar bcud la 'du// mgon de'i bzhed gzhung tshangs pa'i ral klung che// rnam dpyod hub kyis btung ba'i lo tsā ba// drang srong dzah+nu las byung gdams pa'i phreng*// gsung rab nor bu'i 'dren byed rba rlabs g.yo// gang zhig snying po'i gnas lugs rab dwangs pa// rnyog bral ji bzhin 'doms pa'i rgyun bzang pos// bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs rtsa brtan phyir// mdo rgyud lta grub tshad ma'i chu bo rnams// kun 'dus bka' brgyud ma dros klu dbang bdag /mchog gnyis dgos 'byung ma ṇir dbang bsgyur nas// mngon mtho'i chos kyis phongs pa'i sems can la// rnam bzhi'i sbyin pas grol ba'i lam rab ston// de lta'i gzhan phan spyod pa bgrang yas shing*// snang tshul 'dir yang sngon smon mthu stobs kyis// ston 'khor tha mi dad pa nyi dang 'od// ha ri tsan+dan dri bsung dung dang mdog /ci bzhin 'du 'bral med pa nges don du// grub kyang kun rdzob dgongs pa'i lha lam nas// chu 'dzin sprin yig phreng bres bka' gsang char// dad pa'i yul sar reg ma thag pa'i mod// yid la rgyas gdab dus ring ser bu'i dgra'i// ngal dub rgyang dor gang gi bka' drin 'od// ci dgar bla na gsal ba kho na yis// nyer 'tsho'i 'byung khams lhag bsam pad tshal gyi// 'dab rgyas ge sar 'dzum pa'i gnyen gcig pu// gang sku'i dkyil 'khor nyin byed gzi byin can// 'gro rgyud nyon mongs mun stug bral nas su// yang dag ye shes lam bzang ston mkhas pa// rgyal sras slob bcas ngo mtshar zhing gi gnas// de tshul skabs gsum bdag pos brjod dka' na// so skye'i blo yis gzhal byar ma mchis kyang*// gsum ldan dad pa'i spu long rab g.yos te// rnam thar mtha' mi mngon las zegs ma tsam// spros 'di'i bsod nams rin chen bye ba brgya// srid mthar 'dzad med bdag gzhan tshogs gsum gyi// rdo rje'i sa la dbugs dbyung stsol ba'i slad// mchog zhal lta dang nges gsang chos 'khor lo// bskor bar gsol ba'i bdog pa ches phra zhing*// ji bzhin rngo ma thogs na'ang rten 'byung rdzas// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du bsgyur byas nas// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phyur bur spungs pa yi// bkod mdzes maṇ+ḍal bzang 'di sems can don// dgongs phyir chos dbyings klong nas bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// de ltar ched du brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mā li ka'i phreng bas mdun sa mdzes par brgyan nas/

de yang gnas dus ston 'khor dam chos phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan pa rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dge mtshan bzang pos spud par byas pa'i cha 'dir/ rnam 'dren yongs kyi rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang mchog gi sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum mthong zhing*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi'i zab don myong nas thugs kyi ye shes rang rgyud smin par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid chen po gang khyod srid 'dir zhabs pad rdo rje'i chos bdun ngo bor bskal brgyar brtan cing*/ 'di nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar du rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba'i rten thog mar skabs gsum lha yi reg bya maṅgas mtshan pa'i phon tshar ma nyams pa srid ring*/ sku rdo rje mi 'gyur ba'i phyir du bstan pa'i mnga' bdag shākya'i rgyal po'i snang brnyan gser las byas pa gsar bskrun khyad mtshar/ gsung rdo rje mi 'gag pa'i rten ta thā ga ta'i mtshan gyi rabs brjod rgya spar ma/ thugs rdo rje 'khrul pa med phyir chos sku'i mchod sdong bka' gdams li rnying byin chen/ stan dkar rdo rje dang g.yung drung gi re khā bkra ba/ rin gnyis maṇ+ḍal ri rab mtsho gling mtha' yas zhing khams kyi bkod pas mdzes pa/ ting shag dngul lung can/ gos jus ser po dang*/ sngon po bcas sgril gnyis/ tshan dang por lha rdzas phyi mdzod dang*/ gos ser yug gtsos dgu tshan/ gnyis par lha rdzas/ gos dmar gtsos dgu tshan/ gsum par lha rdzas dang*/ gos sngon sogs dgu tshan/ bzhi par lha rdzas ling dmar yug gis gtsos bdun tshan/ lnga par lha rdzas dang*/ gos ling sngo nag sogs bdun tshan/ phying khra/ sbu har ko bub/ sag sngon bub/ dngul gyi rna rgyan/ ral gri/ shing ye ljon 'dab 'khor drug cu/ gzhung ja 'khor drug nyi shu/ rta chibs chen gnyis/ chibs hrol gnyis/ dkyus rta bcu/ dre'u gsum/ rgya dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu/ mtha' dkar ka shi yug bcas rnam grangs brgya phrag phyed gsum la yon tan gyis lhag pa 'bul lam zhu zhu/

slar gsol ba/ mchog tu 'gyur ba med pa'i chos dbyings khams// mchog gi yon tan yongs rdzogs sgyu drwa'i 'phrul// mchog rnams rigs bsdus spyi dpal skur bzhengs pa// mchog zhabs zhing 'dir rtag brtan 'tsho gzhes gsol// dpal ldan sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid// dpal kun 'byung gnas gdod ma'i tshe mtha' yas// dpal 'bar 'chi med rdo rje yongs grub gang*// dpal mgon dam par chos ston 'tsho gzhes gsol// mi shigs gzhom bral gur khang rab 'tsher dbus// mi 'gyur gsang gsum gzi byin rab gsal ba// mi nub bgrang yas bskal chen rab gnas bar// mi 'jigs seng khrir 'tsho gzhes rab brtan gsol// rang byung lhun rdzogs ngang las ma bcos sku// rang shar klong du bri gang mi mnga' yang*// rang snang gdul byar rjes su dgongs pa yi// rang rtsal thogs pa med bzhin zhabs brtan gsol// chos nyid rnam par dag pa don dam bden// chos can kun rdzob bslu med bden 'bras dang*// deng 'dir gsol btab smon pa'i bden stobs kyis// bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gdul bya rjes 'dzin gsol// tshogs gnyis dpag par dka' ba'i legs byas rang gzugs gser gyi lhun po bzhin// chos kyi rgyal po rnam 'dren stobs bcu'i yon tan mnga' ba'i dpal ldan pa// mgon po zla ba nya 'dra'i dkyil 'khor ji ltar srid na lham me ba// dus gsum kun tu dge ba'i mchog ster bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /des gsung dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rnam mang rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas// zhi ba chags bral smra bsam brjod sogs blo yi yul las ring song ba'i// mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i rdo rje'i dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu'i nges pa can// 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin rab dge'i dpyid du bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /pha rol phyin bcu'i don la rab gnas rig deng grol ba'i sar bzhugs pa'i// yang dag nges pa'i lam ston rgyal sras 'phags pa byang sems dge 'dun tshogs// srid zhi'i gdung sel 'gro ba'i bla mar mchod 'os nam mkha'i nor bu'i 'od// rtag par nongs med dge mtshan dang bcas bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog

/shākya'i spyan sngar ji ltar bden mthong gang gi ring lugs gdugs dkar po// bla na 'degs shing chos kyi rgyal srid skyong la g.yel med snying stobs ldan// tshangs dang lha dbang rgyal chen bzhi sogs dkar po'i phyogs kyi sde ris kyis// deng 'dir bsam don dge legs yongs 'grub bkra shis kun tu khyab par mdzod// sarba kā l+ya ṇo ma no ra the pūr+khaṃ bha ba tu/// / ༈

zur mang gar sprul pa'i 'bul tho bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti/ don grub lha rnams kun gyi lha// rdo rje'i tshe mchog dkyil 'khor bdag /'chi med pad+mā kā ra dang*// rnam dbyer med pa'i dpal ldan pa// gang gi zhabs zung gser 'khor lo// seng ges btegs pa'i khri drung du// sgo gsum 'dud pa dang bcas nas// dad pa'i me tog man+dā ra// 'thor bzhin mchog gi dpal yon la// dang ba bskyed nas gsol 'debs spro// deng dus rgyal kun thams cad kyi// rang gzugs nyid du bskal sngon nas// rang don mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i// mngon par sangs rgyas grub na yang*// gzhan don rlabs chen spyod pa yi// phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i mthus// bsam bzhin srid par nyer bzung ba'i// rnam rol zla shel ri bong can// yid can mos pa'i rdzing bu yi// nyes gsum rnyog pa bral ba'i ngor// der snang mos ngor 'char ba las// bsam mi khyab pa'i gzugs kyi sku// thugs rje'i 'od dkar zer phreng g.yo// gdul bya ku muta gnyen gcig pu// ljongs 'dir khyod las gzhan su zhig /des na lhag par phyag byar gnas// ston pa bde gshegs thub mchog dang*// mtsho skyes rdor 'chang ring lugs kyi// snying po zab gsang nges pa'i don// dri bral theg pa'i 'jug sgo rnams// ji bzhin 'chang la thogs med kyi// mkhyen pa'i ye shes rab gsal ba// chags thogs med pa'i rang bzhin gyi// gsang ba gsum gyi 'khor lo nas// sna tshogs chos kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun// nyon mongs dag byed sim pa las// byang chub thar pa'i skyed tshal bzang*// rab tu rgyas pa'i gsos dam pa// ma 'dris yongs kyi mgon gyur gang*// deng 'dir bdag sogs las smon gyi// bgo skal nyid du mngon shar nas// gsang gsum dkyil 'khor mjal nas su// byin rlabs dbang bzhi stsol ba yi// bka' drin srid mthar 'khor dka' yang*// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin dmigs pas// 'bul 'di brtse bas bzhes su gsol// zhes mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang nas// dngos po'i yo byad rten 'byung gi rdzas su bstar ba'i thog mar lha rdzas gangs mdog dkyus ring*/

rgya dngul rta rmig ma rdil tshad gcig /phyi mdzod/ gos jus yug /ras yug gnyis/ 'ga' dkar/ 'brug khra pa sangs kha ba yug bcas bdun tshan/ rta chibs chen gcig /chibs hrol gcig /dre'u gcig bcas 'bul lam zhu/ slar yang ched du gsol ba/ de lta'i legs byas phun tshogs dpal 'bar ba// yongs grub thogs pa med pa'i dge mtshan gyis// mngon par brgyan pa'i tshogs gnyis lhun rdzogs pa// 'dis mtshon bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags yod kyi// dge tshogs gcig tu bsdus nas 'bul ba'i mthus// bsil ljongs ston pa gang khyod gsang ba gsum// rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtag tu mi g.yo bar// mi 'gyur gdod ma'i 'chi med dbang bsgyur nas// nam mkha' de srid 'tsho gzhes brtan gyur cig /rgyal bstan dar zhing skye dgu chos ldan zhing*// bdag dang bdag gi 'brel gyur ci snyed pa// kun kyang bsam don yongs grub mthar thug tu// bla med sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog thob pa'i// thugs bskyed dam pas rjes su 'dzin pa nas// rtag par nongs pa'i nyes tshogs rgyang bsring ba'i// bkra shis don gnyis mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// sarba maṅga laṃ shu bha puṣ+ṭiṃ/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ thog mtha' bar du dge ba can// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor khyon yangs po'i// mnga' bdag mchog dngos grub pa'i gter// rdo rje 'chang dbang zhabs pad+mo// 'jigs bral gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri// srid zhi'i bla na mngon mtho'i drung*// gus pas 'dud phyag sngon btang nas// dad dang mos pa mi phyed blo// bcos min shugs 'byung gsol ba'i mchid// dgyes pa'i rol mor spro phyir 'bul// rnam mang legs byas rgya chen gyis// ring nas shis par byas pa yi// rmad byung ya mtshan ngo mtshar gnas// rtag par 'char ba'i dus kyi char// deng yang 'byams klas brjod 'das kyi// bskal mang gong nas byang chub mchog /spyad pa spyod pa'i chos kyi sku// mngon du gyur kyang tshur mthong gi

/snang tshul sprul pa'i gar ston pa// thugs bskyed dam bca'i khyung sngon skyes// bskul ba'i sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i 'od// nyin byed mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar bas// las nyon mun par bying ba yi// log rtog drwa bar 'thums pa rnams// gcig char bcom zhing drang nges kyi// chos rnams 'chad la bsnyems bral ba// skal ldan gdul bya'i skyed tshal du// gang gi byin gzis reg pa'i mod// rang byung ye shes puṇ+ḍā ri// 'dab brgya grol bar byed pa yi// yang dag gnas la ma smad pa'i// blo mig dang ldan bh+ra ma ra// 'khor ba'i skal bzang kun dga'i dpyid// smin pa'i 'od zer 'bum brdal bas// 'tsho zhing brtas par longs spyod pa'i// rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston dpal// ngom pa ji lta'i thugs rje'i mdangs// rab tu gsal 'di'i bka' drin cha// gzhal bar dka' yang bdag gzhan gyi// dus gsum dge tshogs gcig bsdus shing*// dngos 'byor kun bzang smon lam bzhin// yid sprul mchod par bstar nas su// maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi sogs// lha mi'i dpal 'byor thams cad kyis// phyur bur bkang nas 'bul ba dang*// lhan cig rten 'byung skyes bzang rnams// 'bul 'di brtser bzhes byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i 'dud pas gsol ba'i mchid kyi mdun bdar nas skyabs 'og pa karma dam chos lhun grub kyi 'bul mtshon skyabs 'jug rten thog mar lha gos kai la sha'i mdog can phon tshar ma nyams pa/ tshan dang por lha rdzas phyi mdzod/ gos yug /ling yug gnyis/ ras yug gnyis/ pa sangs kha pa bcas bdun tshan/ bzang ja chung 'ju shing ye 'khor drug bzhi/ rgya dngul srang nyer lnga bcas 'bul lam zhu zhu/ slad ma'i char yang gsol snying re 'bras ni// dzam+bu bṛk+ṣas mtshan pa'i ljongs 'di yi// thub bstan gsal bar byed pa'i gnyen gcig pu// gang khyod las gzhan dmigs su ma 'tshal ba// 'phags pa rnams kyi ri mor bya ba'i yul// des na mos blos yar gzhal tsam min par// dad pa gsum gyis rgyud bskul gsol 'debs kyis// bdag sogs gdul bya rgya mtsho'i dpal mgon du// gsang gsum ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin mchog

/ye nas grub phyir don dam 'pho med kyi// bde chen rtag pa'i ngo bor dbang bsgyur ba'i// mi shigs dwangs ma chen po'i skur bstan nas// bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes rdo rje'i khri 'phang la// bzhugs su gsol 'debs mdo sngags ring lugs gang*// 'dzin skyong spel dang bshad sgrub phrin las kyis// khor yug kun khyab rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar gsol// skyabs 'og chud pa'i gus ldan rnam kun tu// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub cing tshe dpal rgyas// gdod ma'i gnas lugs mngon sum rtogs pa yi// thugs rjes bdag rgyud smin grol dngos grub stsol// sarba maṅga laṃ kur+wan+tu/// / ༈ de nas dpa' bo rin po che'i drung du 'bul ba'i tho yig ni/ swa sti bha wan+tu/ gtsug lag zab mo'i gnas rnams kun// yongs rdzogs chos kyi rgyal po mchog /'gro ba'i gdung sel pad+ma'i gnyen// bstan 'dzin nam mkha'i nor bu zhes// rgya mtsho'i gos can kun gsal ba'i// 'jig rten che dgu'i mchod 'os gnas// zhabs pad gser gyi shing rta'i khri// cang shes bdun btegs gang drung du// rab dkar dge ba'i dpal gang dag /gcig tu spungs pa'i bde legs kyis// shis par byas pa'i rdzogs ldan dus// gsar bzhad lta bu'i deng gi char// gus dang 'dud bcas dang ba'i yid// lhag bsam rin chen 'byung gnas kyi// gting nas thon pa'i puṇ+ḍā ri// mos blo'i 'dab brgya grol bzhin par// ngo mtshar ge sar 'dzum nas su// rig pa'i 'phrul gyi bh+ra ma ra// 'khor zhing snyan sgrogs mgon khyod kyi// yon tan zer phreng 'bum brdal ba'i// cha shas tsam zhig blor bkod nas// gsal 'di don dang ldan par sems// ring nas sbyangs pa'i goms stobs kyis// rgyal dang rgyal sras gzhan dag las// ches cher brjid pa'i thugs bskyed phul// sgrol byed dbus su chu shel can// de lta'i bsnyems pa'ang 'phrog byed pa'i// gdod nas dag pa chos kyi sku// 'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin klong*// mtha' bral chen por lhun grub pa'i// rang mdangs ma 'gags longs skur shar// nges pa lnga ldan zhing gi bdag

/de las khyung sngon skyes drangs pa'i// cir yang snang ba sprul pa'i sku// rig rtsal rol pa mtha' yas pa// gdul dka'i bla na mngon 'char ba'i// gzhan phan thugs bskyed kyis bskul nas// mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor nyin mor byed// gsang gsum rdo rje'i 'od stong gi /phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'dod dgur sgyur// rgyal bstan mdo sngags ring lugs gang*// dga' tshal rgyas pa'i dpyid 'gyur zhing*// 'gro rgyud ma rig khri mun dpung*// bral nas theg pa mchog gi lam// ma nor lta ba'i gnas thob byed// gang drin las byung gzhan du min// des na rab 'byams ston pa kun// khyod skur rdzogs pa nges byas nas// bslu med nyid du yongs grub mod// khyad par sngon smon btsan po yi// rjes 'brel zab mo'i dgongs pa las// 'dir snang me tog bgo skal du// mngon sum tshad mar mched zlar bzhengs// tshul 'di e ma skal bzang rmad// phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ni// dge legs yongs 'du'i gnas dam par// mgon khyod gser zhal lham me ba// mjal ba'i bka' drin gzhal dka'i gnas// dngos po'i skyes bzang ches phra yang*// yid kyi maṇ+ḍal ri mtsho gling*// lha mi'i dpal 'byor bkod mdzes pa// bye ba brgyar sprul 'bul ba dang*// lhan cig rten 'byung bdog pa rnams// mchod sprin rgya mtshor spro bar bgyi// de yang thog mar bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dkyus ring maṅga'i ri mos mtshan pa phon tshar ma nyams pa// sku rten rang byung rgyal ba'i gser sku/ gsung rten tshe mdo gzungs/ thugs rten bka' gdams mchod rten/ stan dkar rdo rje'i re khā bkra ba/ dri ldan gyi phyag rtse'i skor/ zhabs chag cha/ lnga tshan gcig /bdun tshan gcig /dgu tshan gcig /shing ye 'khor drug gnyis/ ko rtse 'khor drug brgyad/ chibs bkra shis dung leb/ mtshal bu rlung gshog /rol rta gnyis/ dkyus rta gsum/ dre'u gcig /mdzo gsum/

khal lnga/ dngul srang brgya/ zam dkar yug bcas 'bul lam zhu zhu/ slar yang gsol ba/ rang byung gzhi las 'gyur med chos dbyings khams// rtag brtan bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang*// chu zla'i gar rol rnam 'phrul sna tshogs gzugs// cir yang bsgyur ba'i bdag nyid zhabs brtan gsol// 'phur 'gro'i slob dpon mtshor 'khrungs rdo rje 'chang*// snyigs lnga'i bstan 'gror rjes dgongs rgyal tshab tu/ bsngags pa'i dbugs dbyung dam par dbang bskur ba// rig 'dzin grub pa'i sar gnas 'tsho gzhes gsol// gsang sngags theg pa'i rtse rgyal a ti'i chos// zab don snying po'i bum bzang gtams nas su// skal bzang bcud du smin grol gaṅgā'i klung*// ji bzhin rnam kun chos 'khor bskor gsol 'debs// dge des dri med nges gsang bstan 'phel zhing*// 'dzin skyong gces spras ldan rnams 'tsho zhing brtan// rgyal khams bde dga'i nyer 'tsho rgud pa bral// rtag par zhi ba'i bdud rtsis sim gyur cig /bkra shis dpal gyi legs byas gzhi// rtag brtan mi 'gyur rdo rje can// gzhar yang g.yo med gzhan rkyen spang*// gang 'dir bkra shis skyong gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/ su dza yan+tu/ shu bha puṣ+ṭiṃ/// / ༈ swasti dza yan+tu/ phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum// mi 'dzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod 'dzin pa// dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug karma pa'i// bstan pa'i phrin las 'dzin pa gang drung du// deng yang phun sum tshogs pa'i dus kyi char// dge legs bye bas gtams pa'i dpal gang dag /ma tshang med pa lhun gyis grub pa yi// dus 'dir bsod nams tshogs zung 'bras smin pas// bstan 'gro nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur gzugs kyi sku// smon lam byams pa'i go cha cher bsgos pas// gang zhig skye dgu'i rgud pa rgyang bsring phyir// legs byas bla na med pa'i yon tan tshogs// yongs 'du dbang po lta bu rab brjid pa'i// rgyal sras thu bo'i tshul 'dzin byang chen gyi// spyod pas sgrub brgyud snying po'i ring lugs gang*// 'dzin skyong spel dang thos bsam sgom stobs sogs// dam pa'i rnam thar rjes su skyong bzhin par// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob nyid du bsngags 'os pa'i// shis brjod skabs gsum me tog man+dā ra// mngon par 'thor bzhin dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod pa'i// ming gi dbang bskur seng khrir mnga' gsol ba'i// rten cing 'brel 'byung rmad du byung ba dang*// khyad par rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i mthu stobs dang*// dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi'ang mgrin gcig tu// swa sti sid+dhi zhes pa'i sgra dbyangs dang*// puṇ+ḍā ri ka'i char chen bsnyil bzhin par// dge ba'i mtshan mas kun tu khyab byas pa'i// deng 'dir phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi// gsang gsum mi nub rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig

/ces ched du brjod pa'i tshig gis mdun bdar nas/ dngos po'i legs skyes mtshon par thog mar bkra shis pa'i lha gos rab dkar/ sku rten du o rgyan rin po che'i gser sku/ gsung rten bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil chog /thugs rten rdor dril bcas dang*// yang rab dkar lha rdzas/ ling ljang yug /zam dmar yug /'ga' khra yug /sbre/ wa/ g.yi/ gzig bcas kyi pags pa/ gser sga chas 'khor tshang ma/ chib pa gra dkar rlung gshog /chib rol gcig /rgod ma gcig /mdzo/ mdzo mo/ 'bri/ khal/ mtha' dkar dang bcas 'bul zhus la dgyes brtses rol pa 'tshal/ slar yang smras pa/ ston mchog zhi ba chags bral tshogs kyi mchog /mchog gsum thugs rje can gyi byin rlabs 'od// 'od stong gsal bas gang 'dir bde legs dpal// dpal dang ldan pas rnam kun shis gyur cig /tshangs sogs lha yi bden pas rgyal ba'i bstan// bstan 'dzin phrin las mthar phyin bzhed pa'i don// don gnyis yongs 'du'i bzhed dgu lhun gyis grub// grub gnyis dngos kun mchog thob bkra shis shog// / ༈ 'bul lan skor bzhugs/ chos kun rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag pa'i// 'dus ma byas pa'i rang gzugs klong yangs su// ji snyed ma lus pra phab rang bzhin can// rtogs pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin khyod kun tu rgyal// deng yang gzod nas gzhan rkyen ma gos pa'i// sems bskyed rnam dag khams las yongs grub pa'i// snying stobs zab mos sra brtan ya lad bgos// byams pa'i dpung dang stong nyid mtshon cha yis// gzung 'dzin dri ma yid srubs mda' lnga pa// pha mthar bskrad pa'i dpa' bo'i ngang tshul la// ring nas goms pa'i tshogs gnyis stobs chen po// smin pa'i sku 'tsho dpag bsam ljon bzang bzhin// sbyong yon bcu gnyis yon tan rab brjid pa'i// gzhan dring mi 'jog thabs mkhas lo 'dab rgyas// 'gro kun dus kyi tsha gdung 'gog pa yi// bde bar ngal gso'i bsil grib sim pa bskyed// gzhan phan lhag bsam rtsa ba rab tu brtan// 'jig rten mchod 'os bstan dang de 'dzin rnams// dgyes rol yongs 'du me tog rnam bkra bas// bla med bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'dab stong grol// zag med bde ba chen po'i ye shes ngang*// rnam par mi rtog skye med mkha' 'dra ba'i// gnyug ma spros bral gshis kyi rang gdangs las// rtogs tshogs ge sar bzhad pa'i phreng ba mdzes// khor yug byar med skyong ba'i dri bsung gi

/bsod nams ba skal bar brjod dka'i gnas las ci// snang tshul rten 'byung ya mtshan ltad mo'i 'phrul// 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i longs spyod kyis// mos blo'i rgyud bskul zhabs tog dgu phrug gi /mchod sprin bar med spro dang lhan cig par// gsung ris rten bzang dngos po'i bdog pa las// dam tshig gces spras lha rdzas dri med dkar// de nyid gzhi brtan sa zla zung 'jug grangs// 'brel tshad thar lam skyel ba'i cang shes rta// spu sdug sprin shugs ldan pa bcu phrag gsum// zhing gi yon tan rdzogs phyir rin gnyis kyi// pad+ma spungs pa'i re khā bkra ba bcas// brda' rtags rten 'brel 'char sgo'i dpyid du ni// son bzhin yid kyi bung ba bde stong gi /ye shes rgyud la skyes mtshungs spro dgar rmad// 'dir yang skyabs gsum nyin byed gzi byin gyi// dpal la brten mthus 'byung khams snyoms pa nas// bstan 'gror sman bde'i 'dun khul dang bcas te// bsam gtan khang bur chos spyod zol du mchis// 'phags chen mched dang mchog zung nyan rang tshogs// ci bzhin dge 'dun rnams kyang spangs rtogs kyi// yon tan dga' tshal rgyas pa'i zil mngar la// mtha' bzhi'i yid can rkang drug 'du bzhin par// bden bzhi'i bcud kyis 'tsho ba'i dpal sbyin gnas// gzhan du mi bdag 'bangs 'khor dri bzhon ltar// gya gyu'i spyod tshul kun tu g.yo ba yi// mnga' ris grang reg kho nas dus 'da' zhing*// bde ba'i bar mtshams dben pa'i go skabs bral// 'on kyang gzhar yang mi bslu'i dkon mchog dbyings// mi phyed 'dun pa'i skya rengs kyis bskul tshe// thugs rje'i 'od stong spro bar cis mi 'gyur// des na tshad med bzhi ldan smos ci dgos// mtshams 'bras slad char gang sku bsnyel med par// dus kyi 'gyu bas ma gtses sgo gsum po// rdo rje gsum ldan dwangs ma'i skur grub nas// mi shigs rtag pa'i ngo bor 'tsho brtan ngos// sngon tshe lhar bcas 'gro mgon bcu gsum pa// bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang ba'i byin rlabs kyi// 'pho dbang zab mos stan thog gcig sangs rgyas// dngos su 'grub pa'i gsang sngags nye lam mchog

/ma hā mudra tshangs ral gaṅgā'i klung*// nyid kyi skal bar snod ldan bum bzang gtams// rgyud grol ye shes rdo rje mngon gyur bzhin// gdul byar 'os pa'i rigs can gang dag rnams// smin pa'i 'gro sgrol rlabs chen spyod pa yi// yang dag lam la 'god pa'i ded dpon dang*// rgyal bstan mchod cing skyong dang spel ba sogs// dam pa'i rnam thar rjes su slob mtshungs pa'i// ji ltar sems bskyed 'bras gang gegs med par// dngos su grub dang 'grub gyur mchis so cog /de ltar don dang ldan phyir smon lam gyi// rgyas gdab rdo rje'i bden tshig spel yod cing*// 'brel gyur rnams kyang 'di gtan bde thob phyir// bsngo bas mtshams sbyor bgyid pa'ang dgongs chub nas// mol mchid dal 'babs rgyun bzhin chad med 'tshal// rab dkar lha rdzas bkra shis re khā bkra// chos kyi rgyal po shākya'i sku brnyan dang*// bstan pa'i gsal byed dharmā kā ra yi// sku brnyan gser las legs byas mtshan dpe'i cha// gzi 'bar byin rlabs stobs kyis rab brjid pa'i// mchod pa'i rten du 'os pa nyi zla zung*// rdo rje'i mdud dang dam rdzas le tshan dang*// tsi na'i chu gos las grub bla bre bcas// skyes bdag bgrang bya'i mgo zla'i dbang phyogs kyi// rgyal ba dang po'i gral tshes dge ba la// dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gdan sa yi// yang dben don grub bde chen dga' gling nas// spel ba'i ku hu mgrin glu dang bcas te// skyes bzang ldan pa'i 'dab gshog brgyar byas nas// ga la ba der bsod nams ljon pa'i rtser// dge bar 'bab dges kun tu dge gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/ su dza yan+tu/ shu bham/

zhes gnas mdo bla ma yan lag mchog gi 'bul skyel 'byor len la bsring pa'o/// / ༈ de nas sman pa bla ma tshe brtan gyi yun 'tsho'i lan du spel ba ni/ swasti/ rnam dag bslab gsum rin chen khang bzang dbus// 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gter gyi 'dod 'jo'i bum// snying stobs zhum med 'dzin pa'i dzī wan+ta// gu ru ā yu tiṣ+ṭha rgyal gyur cig /gang khyod ring nas ma 'dris bshes rnams kyi// rjes slob dge tshogs 'bras bu rlabs chen po// dus smin sku 'tsho sā la'i ljon dbang ltar// brtan cing yongs la phan bde'i lo 'dab kyi// grib bsil snum pos skyong dang chabs cig par// 'dir yang rnam kun brtse ba'i mi phyed 'dun// dad dang dam tshig rab dkar kai la sha// ji bzhin rtag 'grus ngang nas rten 'byung rdzas// rin thang gzhal dka'i mtshan dpe'i cha rdzogs pa'i// rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas pa'i sku brnyan mchog /su war+kha las grub pa'i bzo khyad can// lha rdzas dri med 'bel mchid re khā bcas// 'byor ba dge ba'i mtshan ma gsum ldan pa'i// legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla bzhin cha gang gyur// de lta'i bsod nams bye ba'i rdul brtsegs kyis// phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs khyab nas// bstan 'gro'i mgon gyur gang na su bzhugs pa// 'tsho brtan gsol zhing de mthus bdag lta'ang*// 'byung 'dus bden pa rtag pa ther zug pa'i// mi shigs rdo rje g.yung drung khams grub cing*// rgyal bstan rnam par dag pa gang dag la// bya ba rgya cher 'grub par smon pa dang*// skye dgu chos la sbyor ba'ang 'dun pa bcas// de kun gang gi sems bskyed zab mo'i 'phrul// ma smad chos can chos nyid bden stobs kyi// mthu las nges par 'grub pa'i rang bzhin 'gyur// slad char nyi zla 'od zer tsan+da dri// ji bzhin dpon slob 'du 'bral med par gnas// nyid kyang bgrang bya rtser son mthar phyin nas// bzhed don mtha' dag 'bad med mthar phyin zhing*// rnam kun ye shes snang ba rab rgyas ngos// bkra shis gsung tshogs dbyar mtsho rab rgyas 'tshal// zhes pa'i phrin yig legs skyes lha dar dkar// kasmi ra dang nai pā la yul gyi// tshe yi gsos gyur bzang sman le tshan dang*// bcud kyi snying po shis pa'i rdzas dang bcas// sur+ya byang bsgrod lha yi nyin mo'i dus// dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes bzang la// don grub bde chen dga' ba'i gling nas spel/
